title: Confusion
text: Confusion. I confused the price of this item with another item in my original review. It's a good stand, but not worth the price. I would give it a 5 if it weren't for the price.

product_metadata.title: Coaster Home Furnishings Sunburst 3-Shelf Telephone Stand, Black
features: Can be used as a telephone stand
description: Dress up your family room or kitchen with this accent table. Top shelf is great for landline phones or charging your modern smartphone. Two more shelves look great with a small fern or the latest shopping catalogs. Table is completely finished in black. Starburst design adds a summery disposition.
